name: Standing Side Stretch
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm straight overhead while letting your other arm rest lightly along your thigh or hip.
Lengthen upward through your fingertips, then lean your torso smoothly sideways away from your raised arm while keeping your hips steady.
Feel a long, comfortable stretch running from your hip through your obliques, ribs, and lat.
Hold the stretch calmly with slow breaths on one side, then return upright and switch arms.
tips: Keep your chest facing straight forward rather than twisting or collapsing forward toward the floor.
Breathe deeply into the stretched side of your rib cage.
